verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Netlify Functions and Netlify Blobs using proprietary APIs (e.g., `getStore("file-uploads")` in netlify-docs-12) rather than standard Web/runtime APIs (Fetch, Request/Response, WinterCG) that would enable unmodified cross-platform code. There is no documentation claiming standards-based runtime compatibility or portability across other edge platforms; the pack only shows Netlify-specific CLI, SDK, and storage APIs. Missing for 10: any mention of standard Web API compliance, WinterCG/edge-runtime interoperability, or portability guarantees across platforms other than Netlify.
